decisions.reason: The location-based margin analysis kept its own page in both years and fits the firm's push toward analytical platform services for utilities, so it stays on the market.

The regional electricity tariff calculator went from its own page to a mere mention, but it sits close to the firm's core tariff-calculation business and can be folded into the central platform at little cost, so the firm likely keeps it.

The regional area definition tool lost visibility in 2024, but it is a supporting component for the location-based tariff and margin products and draws on maintained market data, so dropping it would save little.
